research.title: Beyond the Federer paradox in tennis
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Roger Federer won about 80% of his professional matches with only 54% of the points. Hierarchical scoring amplifies small advantages on points into large advantages on matches, but also allows a player to win with fewer. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
